description_en: Clears the disaster recovery drills that were initiated from the secondary disk of a replication pair and deletes the auto-created drill disks
description_zh: 该接口可以清理之前复制对从盘启动的容灾演练，并尝试删除自动创建出来的演练盘
kebab_example: aliyun ebs clear-pair-drill --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --pair-id pair-xxxx --drill-id drill-xxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: ClearPairDrill

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/354276.html operation to query the most recent list of regions in which async replication is supported
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/354276.html查询异步复制功能支持的地域信息
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the replication pair. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/354206.html operation to query the most recent list of replication pairs, including replication pair IDs
parameters.help_zh: 复制对ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/354206.html查询异步复制对列表，获得复制对ID
parameters.name: pair_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the drill. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2584480.html operation to query the disaster recovery drills that were performed on replication pairs in a specific region
parameters.help_zh: 演练ID。您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2584480.html接口查询当前地域下复制对的容灾演练
parameters.name: drill_id
